raw_market.description:
In the third quarter of the NFL game between Eagles and Jaguars, scheduled for October 11 at 9:30 AM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Eagles and Jaguars combine to score 15 or more points in the third quarter.

If the combined third quarter total is less than 15, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
